question.text: Let $\mathrm{A}$ be the region enclosed by the parabola $y^2=2 x$ and the line $x=24$. Then the maximum area of the rectangle inscribed in the region $\mathrm{A}$ is________

solution.text: $\begin{aligned} & A=2\left(24-\frac{b^2}{2}\right) \cdot b \\ & \frac{d A}{d b}=0 \quad \Rightarrow \quad b=4 \\ & A=2(24-8) 4 \\ & =128\end{aligned}$
